blocker: the installed distribution ships the libsumo C++ library (lib64/libsumocpp.so) and its headers, but no Python binding — there is no `libsumo/__init__.py` and no `_libsumo*.so` anywhere under the SUMO root. `pip install eclipse-sumo` therefore does NOT make libsumo importable; a build or wheel that includes the SWIG Python bindings would be required.

claim_boundary.reason: an environment fact about one optional speed path. It measures no closure, ranks nothing and licenses nothing.

consequences.note: The subprocess path remains the only execution backend, so the approved seed-worker budget and every process/memory cap stand exactly as benchmarked. Nothing here licenses raising them: a speed path that does not exist cannot justify more workers.

libsumo.why: in-process SUMO; the whole point of PR G

sumolib.why: network/route helpers the product already uses

traci.why: the socket fallback PR G would replace
